name: concurrency-hunter
description: Find races and lost updates in .NET code, with deterministic evidence, confidence, and a server-rendered report.

interface.shortDescription: Find races and lost updates in a .NET solution
interface.longDescription: Finds races and lost updates across concurrent execution roots in a .NET solution, tracing shared state and synchronization to deterministic source evidence. Results include confidence and a server-rendered report so uncertain analysis remains explicit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run /concurrency-hunter:hunt on this repository and report races with their evidence.
